strengths: A coherent owner's-manual concept, with numbered parts, figure captions and direct, occasionally funny copy.

topFixes: Rebuild the 3D art direction. Blurred skin shading, visibly angular cut surfaces and plastic-looking organs make this feel like a technical prototype beside BioDigital. Improve geometry, normals, material differentiation and lighting before polishing more UI.

Replace the X-ray transparency soup with selective isolation: keep the selected structure opaque, retain only useful anatomical context and suppress unrelated organs. The desktop clitoris state is particularly difficult to parse.

Reframe each camera for the available canvas. On mobile, a huge expanse of upper skin pushes the useful anatomy into the lower half; on desktop, the X-ray model crowds the title and panels. Fit the relevant structures inside explicit UI-safe bounds.

Consolidate desktop controls into a compact tool rail and one inspector. The title, upper-left tools, lower-left simulation panel, bottom view switcher and upper-right content currently create five competing interface islands.

Refine callouts into a consistent annotation system: aligned label lanes, collision avoidance, restrained leader lines and fewer simultaneous labels. Preserve large invisible touch targets rather than making every visible label bulky.

Reduce mobile detail-state chrome. The view tabs, isolation banner, large sheet and persistent toolbar leave a cramped model window. Put isolation status inside the sheet header and provide clear collapsed, half-height and expanded sheet states.

Clarify control semantics and state. 'Slice across' versus 'Side cut' is ambiguous, 'Callouts' looks like navigation rather than a visibility toggle, and the uterus state leaves every view tab apparently inactive. Use explicit action names and distinguish view, visibility and isolation states.

Give the manual a more authored editorial finish: tighten heading spacing, standardize border weights and number badges, and replace the mobile comparison table's awkward wraps with compact paired entries. The current reading section is legible but looks like documentation, not benchmark-class design.

topFixes: Rebuild the external model. The skin is a blurry radial-gradient blob with no form, edge or silhouette, while the hard-edged glossy pink inner geometry looks like plastic pasted on top. It needs real geometry, subsurface shading, a contact shadow and a defined silhouette, because right now it is far below BioDigital and undermines the whole site on first load.

Fix X-ray mode clutter. Fade non-selected systems to around 10–15% opacity and depth-sort them. Show only labels for the active system plus the selection. Stop the 'Fig. 2' caption from colliding with the model, and reserve a clear-zone above the view switcher.

Collapse the four floating cards into two zones: one left rail combining tools, arousal and X-ray, and the right info panel. Drop the card borders so the controls sit on the canvas like Eyes on the Solar System instead of looking like dashboard widgets.

Separate toggles from navigation in the left panel. Give 'Callouts', 'Slice across' and 'Colour code' real switch states, and make 'Parts list' and 'Reset view' plain actions. The black-filled 'Callouts' row currently reads as a selected tab, not an on-state.

Fix the type hierarchy. The right panel H2 ('Start with the exits', 'Clitoral glans') is nearly as loud as the page title. Drop it a step or two, and shrink the mobile segmented control and Tour button, which together eat roughly 15% of the viewport before the model starts.

Demote 'Run an orgasm' from a full-black primary button to a secondary or play-style control. It is currently the heaviest element on screen and competes with the model. Also align the arousal slider tick labels under their ticks; 'Excitement' sits off its tick.

Replace the thick black outline on isolated organs with a rim light or soft halo. Tighten leader-line rules: one angle family, consistent label offsets, and no doubled lines like the 'Vaginal opening' kink on mobile.

Add motion craft: animated camera moves between views, labels that stagger in and track the model, and a hover preview on parts. This is where the benchmarks earn their 9s, and the static screenshots suggest it is missing.
